Reward details
Enjoy benefits valued at over $400 each year
$100: Statement Credit after making Eligible Hotel Purchases
You are eligible to receive a single statement credit of $100 back after spending $100 or more in the aggregate at Wyndham® hotels, Wyndham Grand® hotels, Dolce Hotels and Resorts® by Wyndham, Trademark Collection® by Wyndham and/or Registry Collection Hotels® each calendar year.
Up to $120: Statement Credit after making Eligible Meal Delivery Purchases
Enjoy up to $10 in statement credits back each month--up to $120 each calendar year--after making qualifying meal delivery purchases with your card.
Up to $100: Statement Credit after making Eligible Streaming Service Purchases
Keep your favorite shows streaming and enjoy up to $100 in statement credits back each calendar year after making qualifying streaming service purchases with your card.
$65: Statement Credit after making Eligible Wholesale Membership Club Purchases
Receive a $65 statement credit back each calendar year after making qualifying wholesale club membership purchases with your card.
$95: Value of Your Complimentary Wyndham Insider Membership
Receive a complimentary subscription to Wyndham Rewards Insider (a $95/year value). Unlock a world of exclusive discounts and deals, plus earn points even faster.
Up to $120: Statement Credit after applying for TSA Precheck or Global Entry
Enjoy up to a $120 statement credit back every 4 years for your TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.
Earn 8 points per $1 spent on eligible purchases made at Hotels by Wyndham including Wyndham Travel Bundles.
Earn 4 points per $1 spent on eligible dining, grocery store purchases (excluding Target® and Walmart®) and travel purchases.
Earn 1 point per $1 spent on all other purchases (excluding Wyndham Vacation Club down payments). That means paying bills, buying home office supplies, car repairs, and more are earning you your next great vacation!
Receive 30,000 bonus points each anniversary year after payment of your annual fee.
Automatically receive a Wyndham Rewards DIAMOND member level and enjoy suite upgrades, welcome amenity at check-in at select hotels, and more.
Wyndham Rewards Earner Cardmembers can save even more on our Standard Rate for stays at participating Hotels by Wyndham.
Unlimited Earning – There is no limit to the number of points you can earn.
Redeem 25% fewer Wyndham Rewards points for free nights, which means you can book free nights starting at just 3,750 points.
Redeem your points for free nights at participating Wyndham Rewards properties, online shopping, gift cards and so much more.
Stay 5 nights in a calendar year and earn 30,000 bonus points, enough for a free night.

This APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate.

Balance transfers – Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater.

Important Information
Offer subject to credit approval. Not everyone will qualify for the Wyndham Rewards Visa Signature credit card. This offer is available through this advertisement and may not be accessible elsewhere. Other offers may be available. For complete pricing and other details, please see the Terms and Conditions.
Annual Fee is $395. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening is applicable for the first 15 billing cycles that immediately follow each balance transfer. 0% promotional APR on all "Wyndham Timeshare Purchases" for 6 billing cycles from the transaction date. These introductory and promotional APR offers do not apply to other purchases and cash advances. For new and outstanding balance transfers after the introductory period, outstanding "Wyndham Timeshare Purchases" after the promotional period, and all other purchases, the variable APR is 19.49% to 29.99%, depending upon our review of your application, your credit history at account opening, and other factors. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The APRs on your account will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate and are subject to change. The minimum monthly interest charge will be $1.00. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee 5% (min. $10). Foreign transaction fee: 0%. See Terms and Conditions for updated and more information about the terms of this offer, including the "About the Variable APRs on Your Account" section for the current Prime Rate information.
Information About Free Nights & Discounted Nights with Points + Cash: Free Nights & Discounted Nights with Points + Cash apply to stays in standard rooms at participating properties, subject to availability, blackout dates/rates & other restrictions. Number of points required varies by property. Free Nights range from 5,000-45,000 points per bedroom; Discounted Nights with Points + Cash range from 500 – 9,000 points per bedroom (plus cash). Points typically apply only to room rate (excluding taxes, in the case of discounted nights) & advance fees may be payable at vacation club resorts & vacation rentals. Per night resort fees payable at Caesars Entertainment properties; points can’t be used to pay them. See WyndhamRewards.com/terms for details.
Earning Points and Member Level Details: Conditions and restrictions apply. Without limitation, bonus point offers may require cardmember to meet minimum spend obligations. Please refer to the Introductory Bonus Offer section of the Terms and Conditions for more information about the introductory offer. Please refer to the Reward Rules within the Terms and Conditions for more information about the rewards program. Anniversary Bonus Points offer may not be achievable based on the assigned credit line and ability to maintain that credit line.
Redeeming Rewards: For more information on redeeming activities under the Wyndham Rewards program, visit WyndhamRewards.com/HowItWorks.
$100 Annual Credit for Eligible Hotel Purchases
You are eligible to receive a single statement credit of $100 when you spend $100 or more in the aggregate at Wyndham® hotels, Wyndham Grand® hotels, Dolce Hotels and Resorts® by Wyndham, Trademark Collection® by Wyndham and/or Registry Collection Hotels® each calendar year (January 1 through December 31). To be eligible to receive the credit, the Account must be open and in Good Standing and the Primary Cardmember or authorized user(s) must use their Account for qualifying hotel purchase(s) (e.g. those purchases that appear on your folio for the stay). Qualifying purchases are limited to Wyndham® hotels [wyndhamhotels.com/Wyndham], Wyndham Grand® hotels [wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-grand], Dolce Hotels and Resorts® by Wyndham [wyndhamhotels.com/dolce], Trademark Collection® by Wyndham [wyndhamhotels.com/trademark] and/or Registry Collection Hotels® [wyndhamhotels.com/registrycollection] transactions based on merchant category codes. Barclays does not determine and is not responsible for whether merchants correctly identify themselves and bill purchases as being made at locations in a particular category. Please allow up to 2 weeks after the qualifying Wyndham purchase(s) is charged to your Account for the $100 statement credit to be posted to the Account. Cardmembers are responsible for payment of all purchases on the Account regardless of eligibility for statement credit. This is an annual benefit and the maximum credit available per Account is $100 each calendar year (January 1 through December 31). The posted date that the purchase was made will be used to determine the applicable calendar year. This benefit is subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of Barclays.
$120 Annual Meal Delivery Services Credit
Qualifying meal delivery purchases are eligible to receive a statement credit(s), in equivalent amount(s) as the qualifying purchase(s) up to $10 per month and $120 in the aggregate per calendar year (January 1 through December 31). To be eligible to receive the credit, the Account must be open and in Good Standing and the Primary Cardmember or authorized user(s) must use their Account for a qualifying meal delivery purchase. Qualifying meal delivery purchases are limited to third party services which deliver on behalf of restaurants and businesses as determined by the merchant category code. This does not include delivery services operated directly by restaurants, or services which deliver recipe and ingredient preparation kits. Barclays does not determine and is not responsible for whether merchants correctly identify themselves and bill purchases as being made at locations in a particular category. Please visit cards.barclaycardus.com/banking/cards/wyndham-rewards-earner-premier-card for the up to date list of qualifying transactions. Please allow up to 2 weeks after the qualifying meal delivery purchase is charged to your Account for statement credit(s) to be posted to the Account. Cardmembers are responsible for payment of all purchases on the Account regardless of eligibility for statement credit. This is an annual benefit and the maximum credit available per Account is $120 each calendar year (January 1 through December 31). The posted date that the purchase was made will be used to determine the applicable calendar year. This benefit is subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of Barclays.
$100 Annual Streaming Credit
Qualifying streaming purchases are eligible to receive a statement credit(s) in equivalent amount(s) as the qualifying purchase(s) up to $100 in the aggregate per calendar year (January 1 through December 31). To be eligible to receive the credit, the Account must be open and in Good Standing and the Primary Cardmember or authorized user(s) must use their Account for a qualifying streaming purchase. Qualifying streaming purchases consist of video, music and audio entertainment services. Barclays does not determine and is not responsible for whether merchants correctly identify themselves and bill purchases as being made at locations in a particular category. Please visit cards.barclaycardus.com/banking/cards/wyndham-rewards-earner-premier-card for the up to date list of qualifying transactions. Please allow up to 2 weeks after the qualifying streaming purchase is charged to your Account for statement credit(s) to be posted to the Account. Cardmembers are responsible for payment of all purchases on the Account regardless of eligibility for statement credit. This is an annual benefit and the maximum credit available per Account is $100 each calendar year (January 1 through December 31). The posted date that the purchase was made will be used to determine the applicable calendar year. This benefit is subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of Barclays.
$65 Annual Wholesale Statement Credit
Qualifying wholesale transactions are eligible to receive a single statement credit of $65 once you spend $65 or more in the aggregate per calendar year (January 1 through December 31) on qualifying wholesale transactions. To be eligible to receive the credit, the Account must be open and in Good Standing and the Primary Cardmember or authorized user(s) must use their Account for a qualifying wholesale purchase. Qualifying wholesale transactions will be determined by merchant category code. Barclays does not determine and is not responsible for whether merchants correctly identify themselves and bill purchases as being made at locations in a particular category. Qualifying wholesale transactions include membership fees and annual renewal membership fees. Please allow up to 2 weeks after the qualifying wholesale transaction is charged to your Account for statement credit(s) to be posted to the Account. Cardmembers are responsible for payment of all purchases on the Account regardless of eligibility for statement credit. This is an annual benefit and the maximum credit available per Account is $65 each calendar year (January 1 through December 31). The posted date that the purchase was made will be used to determine the applicable calendar year. This benefit is subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of Barclays.
Complimentary Wyndham Rewards Insider Subscription
You are eligible to receive one (1) gift subscription to Wyndham Rewards Insider. This benefit is fulfilled by Wyndham Rewards. The Primary Cardmember will continue to receive Wyndham Rewards Insider on a complimentary basis through the Wyndham Rewards Earner® Premier Card as long as the Card Account is open and in Good Standing. You will receive an email from Wyndham Rewards to enroll in Wyndham Rewards Insider within 2-4 weeks following application approval. If you already have a Wyndham Rewards Insider subscription, after your existing subscription ends you will no longer be charged for the subscription. Please note if you close your Wyndham Rewards Earner® Premier Card or downgrade to a different Wyndham product, your Wyndham Rewards Insider subscription will end immediately. Wyndham reserves the right to change or cancel the Insider program and benefits at any time with or without notice. For terms and conditions of the Insider program, please visit wyndhamrewardsinsider.com/.
Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® Application Fee Credit
You are eligible to receive a statement credit up to $120 as reimbursement for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® application fee. Global Entry also includes access to TSA PreCheck with no additional application or fee required. This benefit applies to Global Entry or TSA PreCheck only, other Trusted Traveler programs are not eligible. The initial application fee is eligible for the statement credit as well as subsequent credit/s when a membership is renewed. Eligibility to receive the application fee credit will reset 4 years from the prior transaction posting date. You will receive the statement credit for the application fee, after the fee posts to the Card Account. Please allow 1 to 2 billing cycles for the credit to appear on your Card Account statement. Barclays has no control over the application and/or approval process for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck and does not have access to any information provided to the government by the applicant or by the government to the applicant. Barclays has no liability regarding the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck program. The Global Entry or TSA PreCheck program charges an application fee to process the application regardless of whether the application is approved. For more information about the Global Entry or TSA.
